title: i18n: Add course form dict keys to all 3 locales
content:
Add new keys to the admin section of all three dictionary files (en.json, zh-hk.json, zh-cn.json) for course create/edit form.

Keys to add:
- formNameZh: 'Course Name (Chinese)'
- formNameEn: 'Course Name (English)'
- formNameCn: 'Course Name (Simplified Chinese)'
- formSlug: 'URL Slug'
- formCategory: 'Category'
- formIaRef: 'IA Reference Number'
- formCpdHours: 'CPD Hours'
- formPrice: 'Price (HKD)'
- formUnitPrice: 'Unit Price (HKD)'
- formCapacity: 'Capacity'
- formDeliveryMode: 'Delivery Mode'
- formLanguage: 'Language'
- formDescriptionZh: 'Description (Chinese)'
- formDescriptionEn: 'Description (English)'
- formDescriptionCn: 'Description (Simplified Chinese)'
- formGeneralInstructor: 'Instructor'
- formOrganizerZh: 'Organizer (Chinese)'
- formOrganizerEn: 'Organizer (English)'
- formFeeDescriptionZh: 'Fee Description (Chinese)'
- formFeeDescriptionEn: 'Fee Description (English)'
- formFeeDescriptionCn: 'Fee Description (Simplified Chinese)'
- formStatus: 'Registration Status'
- save: 'Save'
- saving: 'Saving...'
- create: 'Create Course'
- creating: 'Creating...'
- update: 'Update Course'
- updating: 'Updating...'
- delete: 'Delete'
- confirmDelete: 'Delete Course'
- deleteWarning: 'Are you sure you want to delete this course? This action cannot be undone.'
- deleteHasRegistrants: 'Cannot delete course with existing registrants. Close registration instead.'
- toastCourseCreated: 'Course created successfully'
- toastCourseUpdated: 'Course updated successfully'
- toastCourseDeleted: 'Course deleted successfully'
- toastCourseDeleteBlocked: 'Cannot delete — course has registrants'
- toastStatusUpdated: 'Registration status updated'

Can be done in parallel with other AD-005 cards.
acceptance: All new keys present in en.json, zh-hk.json, zh-cn.json
AdminDict type auto-infers from en.json (no manual type change needed)
Adding keys first does not break existing admin pages
files: src/dictionaries/en.json (add ~38 new keys to admin section)
src/dictionaries/zh-hk.json (add ~38 new keys to admin section)
src/dictionaries/zh-cn.json (add ~38 new keys to admin section)
dependencies: None — can be done first or in parallel
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && verify all 3 locale files have matching keys
